profile.positioning: A product leader passionate about building scalable, AI-powered solutions that democratize access to financial and real estate opportunities. Currently, as Head of Product at NovaVest, I’m focused on driving traction for our automated investment platform, which utilizes machine learning to provide accurate property valuations and streamline the investment process. Prior to NovaVest, I spent five years developing algorithmic trading strategies at Quantify Capital, where I honed my skills in data analysis, model building, and risk management. I’m a firm believer in the power of technology to disrupt traditional industries and create a more efficient and equitable market. My focus is on identifying key market opportunities, defining a clear product strategy, and assembling high-performing teams to deliver innovative solutions. I’m actively seeking connections with investors and advisors who share my vision for the future of PropTech and understand the complexities of scaling a data-intensive platform. Ultimately, I aim to build a sustainable, impactful company that empowers individuals to build wealth through smart real estate investment.
